digest.component_or_area: backend-neutrality sweep and J7 adapter isolation
propositions: The shared inbound_fields mapper must remain at package root to allow both Jira Cloud and Data Center adapters to use it without violating the J7 sibling-adapter import seal.
Moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira/ would break the J7 bidirectional seal that forbids sibling adapter imports.
Moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira_family/ would violate the mirror-image rule because root-core importers (inbound_differ.py, peer_state.py) are not permitted to consume the family layer.
The backend-neutrality sweep exemption for inbound_fields.py documents a permanent architectural cost, not temporary relocation debt.
The module's by-path lazy load of adapters/jira/adf.py cannot be routed through an intermediate layer without laundering the AST gate.
